en.setting: Silver Creek is a dusty crossroads town where the saloon faces west and the wind blows grit under every door. A land dispute has divided the settlement for months, and the judge who rode in to settle it sleeps in a room above the bar. The dust storm that rolled through at sundown made ghosts of everyone on Main Street.
en.crime: Judge Harlan was found dead in his chair with a bourbon glass beside him. The room smelled of spirits, the window was shut, and the ruling he was to deliver in the morning would never be read.

suspects.name: Cole Bridger
suspects.intro: A rancher whose land claim depends on a survey map that does not match the original.

suspects.name: Clara Moss
suspects.intro: Runs the boarding house above the saloon and was the last person seen entering the judge's quarters.

suspects.name: Deputy Vickers
suspects.intro: Patrolled Main Street that evening, his boot prints crossing the back alley twice.

suspects.name: Reverend Pike
suspects.intro: Disputed the Bridger claim on behalf of the church and visited the judge that afternoon.

suspects.name: Jack Tull
suspects.intro: A rancher who rode in at dusk and lost thirty head when the Bridger fence cut off his creek access.

suspects.name: Maude Bridger
suspects.intro: Kept the ranch accounts, signed the claim papers, and had not spoken to the judge since the hearing.

suspects.name: Doc Calloway
suspects.intro: Examined the body and noted the time, his medical bag containing a labelled vial of strychnine.

es.setting: Silver Creek es un polvoriento pueblo de encrucijada donde el salon mira al oeste y el viento mete arena bajo cada puerta. Una disputa de tierras ha dividido al asentamiento durante meses, y el juez que llego para resolverla duerme en una habitacion sobre el bar. La tormenta de polvo que arraso al atardecer convirtio en fantasmas a todos en la calle principal.
es.crime: El Juez Harlan fue encontrado muerto en su silla con un vaso de bourbon a su lado. La habitacion olia a licor, la ventana estaba cerrada, y el fallo que debia dictar por la manana nunca seria leido.

suspects.name: Cole Bridger
suspects.intro: Un ranchero cuya reclamacion de tierras depende de un mapa que no coincide con el original.

suspects.name: Clara Moss
suspects.intro: Dirige la pension sobre el salon y fue la ultima persona vista entrando en los aposentos del juez.

suspects.name: Alguacil Vickers
suspects.intro: Patrullaba la calle principal esa noche, sus huellas cruzando el callejon trasero dos veces.

suspects.name: Reverendo Pike
suspects.intro: Disputaba la reclamacion Bridger en nombre de la iglesia y visito al juez esa tarde.

suspects.name: Jack Tull
suspects.intro: Un ranchero que llego al atardecer y perdio treinta cabezas cuando la cerca Bridger corto su acceso al arroyo.

suspects.name: Maude Bridger
suspects.intro: Llevaba las cuentas del rancho, firmo los papeles de la reclamacion, y no habia hablado con el juez desde la audiencia.

suspects.name: Doc Calloway
suspects.intro: Examino el cuerpo y anoto la hora, su maletin medico conteniendo un vial etiquetado de estricnina.

fr.setting: Silver Creek est un bourg poussiereux a la croisee des chemins ou le saloon fait face a l'ouest et le vent pousse du sable sous chaque porte. Un litige foncier divise la bourgade depuis des mois, et le juge venu pour le trancher dort dans une chambre au-dessus du bar. La tempete de poussiere qui s'est levee au crepuscule a fait des fantomes de tous ceux dans la rue principale.
fr.crime: Le Juge Harlan a ete trouve mort dans son fauteuil, un verre de bourbon a cote de lui. La chambre sentait l'alcool, la fenetre etait fermee, et le verdict qu'il devait rendre le matin ne serait jamais lu.

suspects.name: Cole Bridger
suspects.intro: Un eleveur dont la revendication fonciere depend d'un plan cadastral qui ne correspond pas a l'original.

suspects.name: Clara Moss
suspects.intro: Tient la pension au-dessus du saloon et fut la derniere personne vue entrant dans les quartiers du juge.

suspects.name: Adjoint Vickers
suspects.intro: Patrouillait la rue principale ce soir-la, ses empreintes de bottes traversant la ruelle arriere deux fois.

suspects.name: Reverend Pike
suspects.intro: Contestait la revendication Bridger au nom de l'eglise et a rendu visite au juge cet apres-midi.

suspects.name: Jack Tull
suspects.intro: Un eleveur arrive au crepuscule qui a perdu trente tetes quand la cloture Bridger a coupe son acces au ruisseau.

suspects.name: Maude Bridger
suspects.intro: Tenait les comptes du ranch, a signe les papiers de la revendication, et n'avait pas parle au juge depuis l'audience.

suspects.name: Doc Calloway
suspects.intro: A examine le corps et note l'heure, sa sacoche medicale contenant un flacon etiquete de strychnine.

physical_evidence.en: The bourbon glass held traces of strychnine, and a vial was found in the alley behind the saloon. Boot prints in the mud crossed the back entrance twice. The judge's notebook lay open to a page with the original boundary line drawn in his own hand.
physical_evidence.es: El vaso de bourbon contenia rastros de estricnina, y un vial fue encontrado en el callejon detras del salon. Las huellas de botas en el barro cruzaban la entrada trasera dos veces. El cuaderno del juez estaba abierto en una pagina con la linea del lindero original dibujada de su propia mano.
physical_evidence.fr: Le verre de bourbon contenait des traces de strychnine, et un flacon a ete trouve dans la ruelle derriere le saloon. Des empreintes de bottes dans la boue traversaient l'entree arriere deux fois. Le carnet du juge etait ouvert a une page avec la ligne de limite originale tracee de sa propre main.

witness_testimony.en: Clara Moss was the last person seen entering the judge's quarters above the saloon. Deputy Vickers's boot prints crossed the back alley twice that night. Reverend Pike visited the judge that afternoon and left before the dust storm rolled in.
witness_testimony.es: Clara Moss fue la ultima persona vista entrando en los aposentos del juez sobre el salon. Las huellas del Alguacil Vickers cruzaron el callejon trasero dos veces esa noche. El Reverendo Pike visito al juez esa tarde y se fue antes de que llegara la tormenta de polvo.
witness_testimony.fr: Clara Moss a ete la derniere personne vue entrant dans les quartiers du juge au-dessus du saloon. Les empreintes de bottes de l'Adjoint Vickers traversaient la ruelle arriere deux fois cette nuit-la. Le Reverend Pike a rendu visite au juge cet apres-midi et est parti avant l'arrivee de la tempete de poussiere.

financial_trail.en: The forged survey map used ink that did not match the land office originals. A telegram confirmed the original boundary would have stripped Bridger's ranch of forty acres. Maude Bridger signed the claim papers herself, and the ranch accounts showed debts that exceeded the land's value.
financial_trail.es: El mapa falsificado usaba tinta que no coincidia con los originales de la oficina de tierras. Un telegrama confirmaba que el lindero original habria despojado al rancho de Bridger de cuarenta acres. Maude Bridger firmo los papeles de la reclamacion ella misma, y las cuentas del rancho mostraban deudas que superaban el valor de la tierra.
financial_trail.fr: Le plan cadastral falsifie utilisait une encre ne correspondant pas aux originaux du bureau des terres. Un telegramme confirmait que la limite originale aurait prive le ranch de Bridger de quarante acres. Maude Bridger a signe elle-meme les papiers de la revendication, et les comptes du ranch montraient des dettes depassant la valeur des terres.

emotional_tells.en: Bridger's horse was tied outside the saloon at sundown and gone by morning. Doc Calloway's medical bag held a labelled vial of strychnine, and his hands shook when he noted the time of death. Jack Tull rode in at dusk with the look of a man who had already lost everything.
emotional_tells.es: El caballo de Bridger estaba atado frente al salon al atardecer y habia desaparecido por la manana. El maletin medico de Doc Calloway contenia un vial etiquetado de estricnina, y sus manos temblaron al anotar la hora de la muerte. Jack Tull llego al atardecer con la mirada de un hombre que ya lo habia perdido todo.
emotional_tells.fr: Le cheval de Bridger etait attache devant le saloon au crepuscule et avait disparu au matin. La sacoche medicale de Doc Calloway contenait un flacon etiquete de strychnine, et ses mains tremblaient en notant l'heure du deces. Jack Tull est arrive au crepuscule avec l'air d'un homme qui avait deja tout perdu.

cold_case_physical.en: The dust storm covered every track on Main Street. The bourbon bottle was emptied and shelved, the vial in the alley washed clean by rain. The judge's notebook pages were torn from the spine, and the room above the saloon was swept before the new judge arrived by stagecoach.
cold_case_physical.es: La tormenta de polvo cubrio cada huella en la calle principal. La botella de bourbon fue vaciada y archivada, el vial en el callejon lavado por la lluvia. Las paginas del cuaderno del juez fueron arrancadas del lomo, y la habitacion sobre el salon fue barrida antes de que el nuevo juez llegara en diligencia.
cold_case_physical.fr: La tempete de poussiere a couvert chaque trace dans la rue principale. La bouteille de bourbon a ete videe et rangee, le flacon dans la ruelle lave par la pluie. Les pages du carnet du juge ont ete arrachees de la reliure, et la chambre au-dessus du saloon a ete balayee avant l'arrivee du nouveau juge par diligence.

cold_case_financial.en: The land claim was never resolved, and the forged survey stayed in the county records unchallenged. The ranch kept its stolen acres, the boundary fence stood where Bridger had built it, and the stagecoach brought a new judge who chose not to reopen the matter.
cold_case_financial.es: La reclamacion de tierras nunca se resolvio, y el plano falsificado permanecio en los registros del condado sin cuestionar. El rancho conservo sus acres robados, la cerca del lindero permanecio donde Bridger la habia construido, y la diligencia trajo un nuevo juez que eligio no reabrir el asunto.
cold_case_financial.fr: La revendication fonciere n'a jamais ete resolue, et le plan falsifie est reste dans les registres du comte sans etre conteste. Le ranch a garde ses acres voles, la cloture est restee ou Bridger l'avait construite, et la diligence a amene un nouveau juge qui a choisi de ne pas rouvrir l'affaire.

all_strong.en: Cole Bridger had poured the strychnine into the bourbon himself, on a night when the dust storm made him invisible. The forged survey, the wrong ink at the land office, the telegram confirming the original boundary — every trail led back to a rancher who would lose everything if the judge ruled at nine. The vial in the alley, the boot prints in the mud, the horse saddled after dark: the frontier delivered its own verdict before the court had its chance.
all_strong.es: Cole Bridger habia vertido la estricnina en el bourbon el mismo, en una noche en que la tormenta de polvo lo hizo invisible. El plano falsificado, la tinta equivocada en la oficina de tierras, el telegrama confirmando el lindero original — cada rastro conducia a un ranchero que lo perderia todo si el juez dictaba sentencia a las nueve. El vial en el callejon, las huellas en el barro, el caballo ensillado en la oscuridad: la frontera dicto su propio veredicto antes de que el tribunal tuviera su oportunidad.
all_strong.fr: Cole Bridger avait verse la strychnine dans le bourbon lui-meme, par une nuit ou la tempete de poussiere le rendait invisible. Le plan falsifie, la mauvaise encre au bureau des terres, le telegramme confirmant la limite originale — chaque piste ramenait a un eleveur qui perdrait tout si le juge statuait a neuf heures. Le flacon dans la ruelle, les empreintes dans la boue, le cheval selle apres la tombee de la nuit : la frontiere a rendu son propre verdict avant que le tribunal n'ait sa chance.

who_strong_rest_weak.en: Everyone in Silver Creek knew Bridger had the most to lose, and the dust storm gave him the cover to do it. But the bourbon bottle told no clear story, the vial could have been anyone's, and the forged survey was never fully proven in open court. Bridger was arrested on the strength of his motive alone. The town called it justice; the law called it thin.
who_strong_rest_weak.es: Todos en Silver Creek sabian que Bridger era quien mas tenia que perder, y la tormenta de polvo le dio la cobertura para hacerlo. Pero la botella de bourbon no contaba una historia clara, el vial podia haber sido de cualquiera, y el plano falsificado nunca fue completamente probado en juicio abierto. Bridger fue arrestado por la fuerza de su motivo solamente. El pueblo lo llamo justicia; la ley lo llamo debil.
who_strong_rest_weak.fr: Tout le monde a Silver Creek savait que Bridger avait le plus a perdre, et la tempete de poussiere lui a donne la couverture pour agir. Mais la bouteille de bourbon ne racontait aucune histoire claire, le flacon aurait pu etre a n'importe qui, et le plan falsifie n'a jamais ete pleinement prouve en audience publique. Bridger fut arrete sur la seule force de son mobile. La ville appela cela justice ; la loi appela cela mince.

wrong_accusation.en: The wrong man swung for it, and Cole Bridger tipped his hat to the marshal on his way out of town. The forged claim stood, the ranch kept its stolen acres, and the judge's notebook pages stayed torn from the spine. Silver Creek moved on — it always does — and the dust covered the tracks of the man who should have hanged.
wrong_accusation.es: El hombre equivocado pago por ello, y Cole Bridger se toco el sombrero ante el alguacil al salir del pueblo. La reclamacion falsificada se mantuvo, el rancho conservo sus acres robados, y las paginas del cuaderno del juez siguieron arrancadas del lomo. Silver Creek siguio adelante — siempre lo hace — y el polvo cubrio las huellas del hombre que debio haber colgado.
wrong_accusation.fr: Le mauvais homme a paye pour cela, et Cole Bridger a salue le marshal de son chapeau en quittant la ville. La revendication falsifiee a tenu, le ranch a garde ses acres voles, et les pages du carnet du juge sont restees arrachees de la reliure. Silver Creek est passe a autre chose — comme toujours — et la poussiere a couvert les traces de l'homme qui aurait du etre pendu.

cold_case.en: The dust settled on Judge Harlan's grave and on the file that bore his name. The land claim was never resolved, the bourbon bottle was emptied and shelved, and the stagecoach brought a new judge who chose not to reopen the matter. Silver Creek dried up a little more each year, and the truth dried with it, cracking like mud in the sun.
cold_case.es: El polvo se asento sobre la tumba del Juez Harlan y sobre el expediente que llevaba su nombre. La reclamacion de tierras nunca se resolvio, la botella de bourbon fue vaciada y archivada, y la diligencia trajo un nuevo juez que eligio no reabrir el asunto. Silver Creek se seco un poco mas cada ano, y la verdad se seco con el, agrietandose como barro al sol.
cold_case.fr: La poussiere s'est deposee sur la tombe du Juge Harlan et sur le dossier qui portait son nom. La revendication fonciere n'a jamais ete resolue, la bouteille de bourbon a ete videe et rangee, et la diligence a amene un nouveau juge qui a choisi de ne pas rouvrir l'affaire. Silver Creek s'est asseche un peu plus chaque annee, et la verite s'est assechee avec lui, se fissurant comme de la boue au soleil.

lucky_guess.en: Bridger's name came up because his horse was tied outside the saloon at sundown and gone by morning. It was barely enough, but in a frontier town, barely enough will do. The trial was swift, the evidence circumstantial, and the verdict carried the weight of public opinion more than legal proof. The dust storm had hidden everything, and the guess that named Bridger was as good as anyone's.
lucky_guess.es: El nombre de Bridger surgio porque su caballo estaba atado frente al salon al atardecer y habia desaparecido por la manana. Apenas era suficiente, pero en un pueblo fronterizo, apenas suficiente basta. El juicio fue rapido, la evidencia circunstancial, y el veredicto llevo el peso de la opinion publica mas que de la prueba legal. La tormenta de polvo habia ocultado todo, y la suposicion que nombro a Bridger era tan buena como la de cualquiera.
lucky_guess.fr: Le nom de Bridger est apparu parce que son cheval etait attache devant le saloon au crepuscule et avait disparu au matin. C'etait a peine suffisant, mais dans une ville de frontiere, a peine suffisant fait l'affaire. Le proces fut rapide, les preuves circonstancielles, et le verdict portait le poids de l'opinion publique plus que de la preuve legale. La tempete de poussiere avait tout cache, et la supposition qui designa Bridger valait celle de n'importe qui.

expressions.suspect:cole_bridger: Cole Bridger tipped his hat and leaned against the rail. His hands were clean but his shirt cuff carried a spot of ink.
expressions.event:poisoned_bourbon: The bourbon contained strychnine dissolved below the burn of the spirit. The dose was precise enough to suggest medical knowledge or careful measurement.
expressions.motive:forged_land_claim: The survey map filed at the land office added two hundred acres to the Bridger claim. The judge had requested the original from the territorial office.
expressions.suspect:clara_moss: Clara Moss ran the boarding house above the saloon and served the judge his meals. She was the last person seen entering his quarters.
expressions.suspect:deputy_vickers: Deputy Vickers patrolled Main Street from sundown until midnight. His boot prints crossed the back alley twice that evening.
expressions.suspect:reverend_pike: Reverend Pike disputed the Bridger claim on behalf of the church congregation. He visited the judge privately the afternoon before the death.
expressions.suspect:jack_tull: Jack Tull rode in from the range at dusk and tied his horse at the livery. His spurs left marks on the saloon steps.
expressions.suspect:maude_bridger: Maude Bridger kept the ranch accounts and signed the claim papers. She had not spoken to the judge since the hearing began.
expressions.suspect:doc_calloway: Doc Calloway examined the body and noted the time of death. His medical bag contained strychnine in a labelled vial.
expressions.location:silver_creek_saloon: The Silver Creek Saloon stands at the crossroads with a porch facing west. The dust blows in under the doors when the wind rises.
expressions.location:judges_quarters: The judge's quarters occupy the upper floor of the saloon, reached by a rear stair. The bourbon bottle stood on the washstand beside a single glass.
expressions.location:land_office: The land office holds survey maps and claim records in a locked cabinet. The clerk's desk faces the door and the safe stands behind it.
expressions.location:main_street: Main Street runs north-south through Silver Creek between the saloon and the livery. The stagecoach stops at the general store.
expressions.location:bridger_ranch: The Bridger ranch lies three miles south on disputed ground. The house is built of cut stone and the corral fence is new.
expressions.location:livery_stable: The livery stable holds eight stalls and a tack room. A saddle bag hung from the fourth peg was not claimed.
expressions.location:cemetery_hill: Cemetery Hill overlooks the town from the east. The dust storm that evening reduced visibility to the length of a horse.
expressions.location:back_alley: The back alley connects the rear stair of the saloon to the livery yard. The door at the top of the stair was unlatched.
expressions.object:bourbon_bottle: A bourbon bottle stood on the washstand, one-third full. A faint residue ring inside the neck does not match the spirit colour.
expressions.object:land_deed: The land deed for the Bridger claim was filed four months before the hearing. The seal is cracked and the paper stock differs from the original.
expressions.object:forged_survey: The survey map shows the Bridger boundary two hundred acres north of the 1868 marker. The ink on the extension line is from a different batch.
expressions.object:poison_vial: A small glass vial was found in the alley behind the saloon. The label reads strychnine and the contents are nearly gone.
expressions.object:court_docket: The court docket lists the Bridger claim as first business for the morning session. The judge had written a note in the margin.
expressions.object:judges_notebook: The judge's notebook was found with two pages torn from the binding. The remaining pages reference the original 1868 survey by page number.
expressions.object:whiskey_glass: A whiskey glass stood beside the bottle on the washstand. The rim had been rinsed but the base still held a residue.
expressions.object:spur_mark: Spur marks scored the saloon porch steps in two parallel lines. The spacing matches a pattern common to ranch-made spurs.
expressions.object:brand_register: The brand register at the land office lists Bridger stock at four hundred head. The tally does not match the ranch accounts.
expressions.object:ink_pot: An ink pot on the land office desk contains ink from a batch dated after the supposed filing of the survey. The clerk denies using it.
expressions.object:boot_print: A boot print in the alley mud shows a size twelve with a square toe. Deputy Vickers wears size twelve.
expressions.object:telegram: A telegram addressed to the judge was found in his coat pocket. The message confirms the original survey contradicts the filed claim.
expressions.object:saddle_bag: A saddle bag at the livery contains a tin of white powder wrapped in cloth. The powder is consistent with strychnine preparation.
expressions.emotion:iron_composure: He did not remove his hat during the interview. His answers were short and his gaze did not leave the corral gate.
expressions.emotion:raw_fury: She threw the door open before the knock finished. Her voice carried across the street and she did not lower it.
expressions.emotion:careful_drawl: Every word came slowly, as if each one cost him money. He paused before the judge's name and continued without inflection.
expressions.emotion:stiff_courtesy: He stood with his thumbs in his belt and nodded at each question. His badge caught the lamplight but his eyes stayed dark.
expressions.emotion:cold_stare: She looked at the inspector without blinking for a full five count. Her hands stayed flat on the table.
expressions.emotion:hollow_sympathy: He shook his head and said it was a terrible loss for the town. His medical bag was already packed when the inspector arrived.
expressions.modifier:glass_rinsed: The whiskey glass had been rinsed with water but not dried. A faint chemical scent remained on the inside surface.
expressions.modifier:seal_cracked: The wax seal on the land deed shows a hairline crack running through the crest. The wax colour differs from the territorial standard.
expressions.modifier:ink_wrong_batch: The ink on the survey extension is from a batch manufactured after the supposed filing date. The batch number is stamped on the pot.
expressions.modifier:residue_ring: A residue ring inside the bourbon bottle neck sits above the liquid line. The colour is lighter than the spirit beneath.
expressions.modifier:dust_storm: A dust storm rolled through Silver Creek at sundown and lasted until full dark. Visibility dropped to arm's length on Main Street.
expressions.modifier:door_unlatched: The rear door to the judge's quarters was found unlatched at dawn. The latch is stiff and requires deliberate force.
expressions.modifier:survey_discrepancy: The filed survey adds two hundred acres that do not appear on the 1868 original. The discrepancy was noted by the judge in his notebook.
expressions.modifier:strychnine_trace: Strychnine residue was found in the glass and in the bourbon bottle neck. The concentration suggests a measured dose.
expressions.modifier:spur_scratch: The spur marks on the porch are fresh and cut through the accumulated dust. They lead from the street to the rear stair.
expressions.modifier:candle_melted: The candle in the judge's room had melted to a stub. The wax pool suggests it burned for at least four hours.
expressions.action:bourbon_poured: The bourbon was poured from the bottle into the glass sometime after the last round. The barkeep did not serve it.
expressions.action:deed_filed: The forged land deed was filed at the land office four months before the hearing. The filing clerk accepted it without checking the seal.
expressions.action:vial_disposed: A strychnine vial was dropped in the back alley behind a barrel. Rain had not yet washed the residue from the glass.
expressions.action:alley_crossed: Someone crossed the back alley between the livery and the saloon rear stair. The boot prints are clear in the dried mud.
expressions.action:survey_altered: The survey map was redrawn with an extended boundary line. The new ink was applied over the original with care but not perfection.
expressions.action:horse_saddled: A horse was saddled at the livery after sundown. The stable hand did not see who took it.
expressions.action:notebook_removed: Two pages were torn from the judge's notebook after the margin notes were written. The tear is at the binding stitch.
expressions.action:door_opened: The rear door to the quarters was opened from outside using the latch. No key was needed and no marks suggest forced entry.
expressions.action:claim_argued: Cole Bridger argued the claim at the preliminary hearing three weeks before. The judge reserved his ruling for the morning session.
expressions.time:sundown_hour: The sun set at half past six and the dust storm began within the hour. Most residents were indoors by seven.
expressions.time:dust_dark: Full dark arrived at half past seven under the dust cloud. The saloon lamps were the only light visible on Main Street.
expressions.time:dawn_found: Clara Moss found the judge at half past five when she brought his coffee. The room was cold and the candle had burned out.
expressions.time:last_round: The last round at the saloon was served at eleven. The barkeep locked the front door at half past.
expressions.time:court_morning: The court session was scheduled for nine the following morning. The Bridger claim was listed as the first item.
expressions.motive:ranch_debt: The Bridger ranch carried a debt secured against the full acreage. If the claim was reduced, the bank would foreclose.
expressions.motive:water_rights: The disputed two hundred acres included the only reliable water source for the south range. Without it, the cattle operation was unviable.
expressions.motive:ruling_fear: The telegram confirmed the original survey. The judge would have ruled against the Bridger claim the following morning.
expressions.motive:old_grudge: Maude Bridger's family had contested the original survey in 1868. The dispute had divided the town for a generation.
expressions.motive:cattle_loss: Jack Tull lost thirty head when the Bridger fence cut off his access to the creek. His claim for damages was pending.
expressions.witness:barkeep: The barkeep served the last round at eleven and saw the judge climb the rear stair. He did not see anyone follow.
expressions.witness:stagecoach_driver: The stagecoach driver arrived at sundown and saw Bridger's horse tied outside the saloon. The horse was gone by morning.
expressions.witness:stable_hand: The stable hand reported a horse saddled after dark. He could not identify the rider through the dust.
expressions.witness:general_store_clerk: The general store clerk sold strychnine to Doc Calloway two weeks before the death. The purchase was recorded in the poison book.
expressions.witness:ranch_hand: A Bridger ranch hand saw Cole ride out toward town at dusk. He returned after midnight with dust on his coat.
expressions.event:judge_harlan_discovered: Judge Harlan was found in his chair with the bourbon glass beside him. The room smelled faintly of spirits and the window was closed.
expressions.event:saloon_evening: The saloon served drinks until eleven on the night of the death. Seven men were present for the last round, including Cole Bridger.
